summary: Georgia list gives 612 (no unit) in Chattahoochee County; a 2017 county plan describes a staffed fire lookout at 123 Fire Tower Road, and county agreements with the Georgia Forestry Commission run to June 2026 without naming the tower.

access.note: The 2017 county plan describes the lookout at 123 Fire Tower Road as staffed seven days a week. The 2025 county agreement provides for a fire-tower operator but does not name this tower. No source describes public visiting rules; the level is inferred from the staffing.

events.note: County wildfire plan dated December 2017: the lookout at 123 Fire Tower Road is staffed seven days a week, with two fire tower operators assigned. This is the staffing as of the plan, not a record of when staffing began.

County approved a one-year agreement with the Georgia Forestry Commission for forestry personnel help with detection, prevention and firefighting, July 2024 to June 2025, payments capped at $4,738.58.

County approved an agreement with the Georgia Forestry Commission to provide a fire-tower operator and fire-tower detection and prevention services, July 2025 to June 2026, payments capped at $4,738.58. This is an agreement, not a staffing roster.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build year, design, height, fires or fate, so the story has no built or fate section. The county plan and the tower list are not linked by any source; the match rests on the county, the tower type and the 'Fire Tower Road' staffing, and the story says so. The tower list gives 612 with no unit; OpenStreetMap's 186, if meters, is about 610 feet and agrees with 612 read as feet. The 2025 agreement is an agreement to provide an operator, not evidence of current staffing. The BLL and GFC register numbers are not explained by any source read. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia page (firelookout.org) has no entry for it. A business-listing search snippet gives a different address (125 Firetower Rd, Cusseta); that page returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Two Citizen Portal articles are news summaries of county minutes. Next steps: Georgia Forestry Commission or Cusseta-Chattahoochee County for build date, ownership and visiting rules.
